name: @flying-dice/tslua-dcs-gui-types
description: Typescript type definitions for DCS GUI environment

scripts.test:export: npm run typecheck:export && tstl -p tsconfig.tstl-export-tests.json && lua51 ./.test/export-tests.lua
scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.tstl.json && tstl -p tsconfig.tstl.json
scripts.test: npm run test:lua && npm run test:export
scripts.test:lua: npm run build:doubles && tstl -p tsconfig.tstl-tests.json && lua51 --preload ./.test/doubles.lua ./.test/tests.lua
